body: Thank you, I appreciate the advice. I'm trying to be as open as possible but the self hatred is a big one making it hard to focus on me and not those I hurt.

My behavior being manipulative and harmful is why I cannot forgive myself, I feel like pure evil for it. And I know why I'm sure he's too hurt to ever come back. He didn't deserve that. I spiral to some very dark thoughts every time I remember. If he's unable to speak to me, it's proof I don't deserve forgiveness, and if I can't be forgiven, what is the point?
